sloka: मातापितृसुतस्नेहैर्भार्याबन्धुमनोरमैः ।मोहितो ऽयं जनो ध्वस्तः क्लेशं स्वं नावबुध्यते ।। ७.२०.१४ ॥
transliteration: mātāpitṛsutasnehairbhāryābandhumanoramaiḥ ।mohito 'yaṁ jano dhvastaḥ kleśaṁ svaṁ nāvabudhyate ।। 7.20.14 ॥

translations.english: At times, joyful people engage in music and dance, while at other times, distressed individuals weep with faces and eyes streaming with tears.
